name: RSS
label: RSS
description: RSS 2.0 / Atom (RFC 4287) via OfficialApiNode. read = HTTP GET of host+path (no scheme; baseUrl is https://). listen = kind:ingress (BPMN message event — this node does not poll or open a socket). Honor feed copyright and robots. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One RSS request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"read"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which operation to run. EXACT: read | listen. read fetches the feed. listen is BPMN ingress. Example: 'read'.

schema.label: host_and_path
schema.description: For read: host + path + query, no scheme. Example: feeds.bbci.co.uk/news/rss.xml

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: read | listen. Example: 'read'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
